blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The University of the Philippines (UP) and the Natural Resources Development Corporation (NRDC) will hold a two-day national consultation on Nov. 20 and 21 in Quezon City to develop a coordinated response to the potential impacts of El Niño. The National Multi-Stakeholder Consultation on El Niño Impact and Response will take place at the GT Toyota Asian Cultural Center in UP Diliman, bringing together government agencies, scientists, community representatives, civil society organizations and businesses. According to a joint press release dated Nov. 13, the consultation aims to produce a National Multi-Stakeholder El Niño Response Action Matrix, which will […]...
